title: beepbox #11
author: ADnova
author_description: A slow happy chiptune loop created with Beep Box.
selection: Short, relaxed happy chiptune loop fits a one-button sheep game; CC0 permits this commercial gift firmware.
conversion_command: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i assets/music/fs_381316_beepbox-11.mp3 -ac 1 -ar 16000 -c:a pcm_s16le -f s16le assets/music/marvy_bgm.pcm
runtime_processing: Background scaled by 1/16, 4 ms seam fades, 16 ms on/off ramps, ducked to 1/4 under original synthesized feedback cues. One 256-sample output buffer.
